nodes.title: Living Culture — Манифесты Velantrim
nodes.summary: Human-facing declarations of meaning, values, direction, and evolving cultural formulations.
nodes.why_read: Open for cultural/philosophical declarations; do not treat manifesto language as a machine manifest or technical requirement.

nodes.title: Living Culture — Песни и поэзия Velantrim
nodes.summary: Navigation surface for music and poetry expressing loss, hope, search, solitude, nature, memory, and creation.
nodes.why_read: Open for cultural works and their versions, prompts, narrative placement, and interpretation while preserving artistic ambiguity.

nodes.title: Living Culture — Архетипы и человеческие истории
nodes.summary: Human-story layer containing figures such as Fugitive, Wanderer/Seeker, Keeper, and Creator.
nodes.why_read: Open for artistic human transitions and story structure; archetype is a creative device, not a diagnosis or required identity model.

nodes.title: Living Culture — Беглец: от утраты к поиску и познанию
nodes.summary: Current interpretive cultural arc: loss → pain → isolation → flight → road → observation → question → search → knowledge.
nodes.why_read: Open for the current Fugitive→Seeker interpretation and its next cultural node; preserve it as interpretive rather than mandatory Canon.

nodes.title: Living Culture — Беглец cultural arc
